name: Genesee GenClone 25-105 6 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Genesee Scientific GenClone 6 well tissue culture plate, GPPS (general polystyrene), flat-bottom round wells, sterile (irradiation, SAL 10-6, ISO 11137), not autoclavable. Cat# 25-105 is the surface-treated item, registered here; 25-100 is the non-treated sibling on the same mould (same drawing, same dimensions) - which of the two is the plate in the requester's lab was not confirmed, see the MR. Dimensions are from the 'Product Specification Sheet, 6 Well Tissue Culture Plates' page of the family PDS GenCloneTCPlatesPDS.pdf (downloaded 2026-08-17; the dimensioned drawing is an image with no text layer, read by rendering the page). Units in meters. Footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm +/-0.25 ('Plate' drawing; the assembled-with-lid footprint on the same sheet is 127.0 x 84.8 mm +/-0.25, smaller, since the lid nests inside the plate rim - lid dimensions are not used here). Plate height (without lid) is 20.2 mm +/-0.15; assembled plate+lid height is 22.2 mm per the Features list, lid not modeled. A1 well center is 24.71 mm from the left edge (column offset) and 23.17 mm from the top edge (row offset); pitch is 39.04 mm both directions (2x3 grid), all four values read directly off the plate top-view drawing. The well cross-section shows two diameters: Phi 34.5 +/-0.15 mm over the first 1.5 +/-0.2 mm of depth from the rim (a narrow entrance/guide ring at the well mouth) widening to Phi 35.3 +/-0.15 mm for the remainder of the 17.0 +/-0.15 mm well depth (the main growth-surface bore, not further dimensioned down to the floor). 'diameter' records the top (entrance) value, 34.5 mm, per the top-diameter convention; the wider 35.3 mm main-bore value is recorded here rather than in a literal 'bottom diameter', since the drawing does not dimension the floor separately - 35.3 mm is the better estimate of usable well width, and is consistent with the stated growth area (9.6 cm^2 vs pi*(35.3/2)^2 = 9.79 cm^2, vs pi*(34.5/2)^2 = 9.35 cm^2 for the narrower entrance). Well depth 17.0 mm is measured from the same top reference as the 1.5 mm entrance feature, not additive with it, and is consistent with max. volume 17.0 mL at 9.6 cm^2 growth area. Bottom (floor) thickness is not separately dimensioned on this sheet. Max volume 17.0 mL, working volume 1.9-2.9 mL. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
